text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — PR #2248 (schema field case) is blocked on two tiny style things: proto field name and gofumpt diff.

maya: which proto? paste the offending line?

jordan: here's the proto snippet:
```
message Organization {
  string orgId = 1; // should be org_id
  string display_name = 2;
}
```

jordan: gofumpt is flagging generated helper names (displayName vs display_name) and CI fails on `gofumpt -w`.

maya: ok. happy path: rename proto to snake_case (org_id) and regenerate. we generally avoid adding gofumpt exceptions.

sam: @jordan quick Q — is this schema user-facing? if yes prefer non-breaking: add new field `org_id` and keep `orgId` with a deprecation comment.

jordan: Not user-facing, internal-only. safe to rename and regenerate.

ci-bot: build/checks report: gofmt/gofumpt: fail on 1 file; compilation and tests passed.

maya: then please push a fixup: run `buf generate` + `gofumpt -w` and update the generated files, small PR is fine to squash.

jordan: will do. pinging @sam for approval once green.

olivia: quick nit — add a short note in the PR body like: "rename internal proto field to snake_case (internal-only)" so future reviewers don't revert.

jordan: done. pushing patch now; will update thread when CI is green :thumbsup:
